QuestInfo.name: Trails of the Lightning
QuestInfo.0:
#bOz#k is calling for you.
Go to #bEreve#k.
QuestInfo.1:
#bHawkeye#k requested that Oz deliver the letter, but Oz said something had come up and she couldn't do it anymore, so she's asking you to do it.

Go deliver the #bSuspicious Letter#k to the large house on the #b#eNorth side of Lith Harbor#k#n.


#b(If there's a problem during the quest, you can forfeit it and start it again.)

#b(If you lose the Suspicious Letter, forfeit the quest and start it again -- or ask around in Lith Harbor to get the letter back.)
QuestInfo.2:
Hawkeye was the only son of a Merchant of Lith Harbor. Tired of being thought of as an overprivileged child, he left his home to pursue adventures out at sea.

He joined the Knights to help people pursue freedom and happiness.
